verdict.rationale: Aircall's own materials describe in-product AI Assistants that give real-time guidance and suggested responses during conversations. Its API also exposes AI-derived call insights (sentiments, topics, summaries, transcriptions), which shows the product generates insights from the user's call data. missing for 10: in-depth first-party docs on how the in-product insights are surfaced and configured, insights beyond individual conversations (e.g. account-level analytics), independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: AI Assistants provide real-time guidance and suggested responses, improving performance in every conversation.
Retrieve sentiments ... Retrieve topics ... Retrieve a summary
